events.title: Demo Update v0.0.3262-beta
events.summary: Multiplayer Rooms now hold up to 48 players. No more automatic parties: everyone starts solo and teams up by invite. New Party page in the menu: how to team up, what a party gives you, invite / accept / leave. You get a notice when someone new joins. Use a Teleport Scroll from the Party page to reach any player, not only teammates. events.title: Demo Major Update v0.0.3190-beta
events.summary: Combat Feel Getting hit now shows on your body: light hits cause a short flinch, heavy boss blows stagger and shove you, and you can tell which way the hit came from. Knockback distance is fixed and no longer changes with frame rate. Regional bosses take about 2 seconds to make their entrance before attacking; the Bellfrost Bear and several regional bosses gain snow throws, icicles, pounces, charges and burrows. events.title: Demo Major Update v0.0.2905-beta
events.summary: Bosses and Difficulty A fourth difficulty, Legendary: bosses strike faster and gain new attack patterns, and rewards now scale with difficulty. Stone Guardian has new moves: an anchor chain that drags the farthest player in, a meteor shower (landed rubble blocks shots for 5 seconds), and stele shards that hunt the farthest player.
